versions.content: Scope of McGroupDataRefSet s McGroupDataRefSet s can refer to the data either via instances of FlatInstanceDescriptor or Mc- DataInstance : • The first possibility, i.e. the association via a FlatMap allows to define McGroup s rather early in the project on ECU or even System level before the actual McSup- port has been generated. • The second possibility, the association to McDataInstance s allows to define (or transform) McGroup s for usage in a self-contained manner together with the McSupport data for A2L generation.
